QuestInfo.name: [The Afterlands] The Lost Storybook
QuestInfo.0: #p9400224# seem to have a request for you. Talk to #p9400224#.
QuestInfo.1: #p9400224# is sad because of a lost storybook. As a result, it has started to rain.\r\nThe storybook was lost outside the house. Perhaps one of the Papercraft monsters picked it up?
QuestInfo.2: When you returned #p9400224#'s lost storybook, the weather cleared up. It felt good to see #p9400224# happy.
